narrative: On the tables. The tables, the same four lines, a candle now. No fifth line has appeared under them. On the tables. The folded leaves in the right hand, writing turned in. The tables are still open beside them. The letter is on the board, flat, not in the hand. On the tables. The letter, full in the candlelight, no wafer. The packet is at the edge of the frame, separate.
